rubric.role_summary: Remote US marketing data analyst on an analytics team, using marketing and media data to measure TV and streaming campaign effectiveness, validate analyses, and explain results to clients and internal teams.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Remote US marketing data analyst on an analytics team, using marketing and media data to measure TV and streaming campaign effectiveness, validate analyses, and explain results to clients and internal teams.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 2+ years of experience in marketing analytics, media analytics, or a related quantitative field.
- Degree in a quantitative field such as business, economics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, marketing, or similar.
- Proficiency in Excel.
- Experience using BI or data tools, such as Domo, Databricks, SQL, or similar environments, to explore and troubleshoot data; no particular named platform is required.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience supporting campaign measurement.
- 3.5 GPA or equivalent academic performance in a quantitative field such as business, economics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, marketing, or similar.
- Ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and connect insights to defined KPIs.
- Excel skills using formulas, pivot tables, and structured analysis to organize, validate, and analyze large datasets.
- Experience building client-ready slides explaining campaign results or analytical findings.
- Experience using AI tools to improve workflows, explore data, or enhance analysis, with an understanding of their strengths and limitations.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States, excluding California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
